title: Exclude the fixed four-clock Type B B2 transfer
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** In the exact signed Type B caller, moving B2 from IDLE_ONE 1855/1869 to 2324/2337 changes the boundary map. On the legal width-one sector with B2=-1, central and other body eigenvalues +1, input role 36 produces old output -17/36 and edited output -13/36 at role 36. The exact forward and independent reverse replays cover all 36 coordinates. This excludes one fixed-clock, fixed-wrapper edit. Other clock sets and changed coframes remain open.

The proposed eight-port ranks 56,56,64,64 → 48,48,72,72 give an optimistic directed gross of [0.12311985005206546, 0.12311985005206547] raw units with unchanged productive ranks. The changed map fails before a supplier build or complete invoice.

## Task and overlap

Refined scope of joint-query-controller. The base is e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, exact comparator #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. #7402 studies a different stage17 transfer. #7296 shares clock 2324 in a different pairing. #7360 treats repeated same-mask squares. The first two commits are the separately scoped shared onboarding prerequisite from #7257, reusing #7147.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-typeb-b2-transfer-exclusion/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-typeb-b2-transfer-exclusion
```

Direct and registered replay, committed-byte check, official Git-free read-only export replay, and 27 local onboarding tests passed. Input hashes and both exact receipts are bundled. The unit-body and omitted-reflection controls passed. A full edited supplier replay was skipped after the exact boundary failure.

## Credit

Clear1nsight supplied #7481 and #7334. #7298 supplies the directed tariff. #7315, #7360 and #7402 supply related projector and caller work. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted implementation, independent replay and packaging.

## Open next questions

Check the rank of the B9 signed endpoint difference through [2324,2356) before building a nested B9–B15 square cancellation at 2324/2355. It would delete one paid job if the represented fields and full invoice permit it.
